summary: MarketAxess Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the execution of a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger on July 29, 2026, with Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (Parent) and its wholly owned subsidiary Igloo Merger Sub II, Inc. Under the terms, Merger Sub will merge with and into MarketAxess, with MarketAxess surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Each outstanding share of MarketAxess common stock will be converted into the right to receive $167.00 per share in cash. The board of directors unanimously determined the merger to be advisable, fair, and in the best interests of the company and its stockholders, and recommended stockholders vote to adopt the agreement. Outstanding options and restricted stock units will be converted into equivalent Parent equity instruments. Key watch items include stockholder vote timing, regulatory approvals, and any appraisal rights.
